reason: The pages that carry the site's search traffic: the QuotationMaker part of peak-durum/traffic-pages.json as it stood on 16 Nov 2026 (rule: clicks > 0 or impressions >= 100 in the last 90 days). Doruk's rule of 15 Oct 2026: they stay exactly as they are. Nothing that is not a decision about the page itself (extra links in the footer, a link group, a test of a box) is added to them: lib/frozen.js is what keeps the shared footer and templates from reaching them. A page on this list gets a box only through content/lead-cta.js.
